About this job
Your Mission
Do you see your future in the world of
electric mobility
and are you passionate about
technological innovation
? Let’s revolutionize the automotive industry together and establish our
Matrix Charging®
technology as the standard of tomorrow.
Tasks
Development and implementation of firmware for embedded systems to meet the requirements of the
industrial
and
automotive
sectors
Development of
software architecture
in coordination with other departments
Independent
technical leadership
of development projects, taking into account time, costs, and quality
Organization and execution of reviews, as well as approval of new software releases
Technical guidance
and development of software team members
Active introduction of new methods and process improvements
Close collaboration with the Head of Software
Requirements
Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, software engineering, telematics, electrical engineering, mechatronics, etc.
Several years of experience in firmware development for complex mechatronic systems
Experience in implementing safety-critical software in industrial and/or automotive environments (ISO 26262, IEC 61508)
Experience with AUTOSAR and/or ASPICE is a plus
Entrepreneurial mindset and a strong solution-oriented approach
Strong teamwork and communication skills
Ability to work independently, systematically, and with a high degree of personal responsibility
Benefits
Exciting responsibilities
: You’ll work in a diverse field with plenty of creative freedom at a rapidly growing electric mobility company.
Technology meets team spirit:
You can expect a collaborative and supportive atmosphere in an innovative, technical environment.
Flexibility & autonomy
: We offer you the opportunity to plan your own work and a work environment where you can thrive.
Fair and transparent compensation
: Because we value talent and personality, we’ll determine your gross salary individually with you. Depending on your qualifications and experience, we offer a gross annual salary starting at €55,000—let’s talk!
